transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal month-end capital distribution routine, I have the proposed $6,000,000 upstream dividend from the regulated subsidiary on my desk for authorization. The subsidiary currently reports $8,000,000 in distributable retained earnings, so on the face of it the payment appears supportable. Before I authorize anything, I need each of you -- capital risk, tax, and subsidiary controllership -- to report any constraints or concerns you're aware of regarding this distribution. Please go ahead.

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a capital risk constraint. My stress test completed this morning shows that the subsidiary can pay no more than $4,000,000 while retaining the required 12.0% post-dividend capital ratio. The proposed $6,000,000 dividend would breach that threshold. Additionally, the stress test requires monthly capital-ratio monitoring for six months. I have not yet entered this result in the distribution worksheet, but I'm bringing it to your attention now so it's on the record before any authorization decision.
